materials.title: When a timetable is not a guarantee

paragraphs.text: When the town of Alder introduced a new evening bus service, the announcement promised a better connection between its railway station and three residential districts. The published timetable showed a bus leaving ten minutes after each of the main evening trains. For passengers who had previously faced a long walk or an expensive taxi journey, the arrangement appeared straightforward. Yet during the first month, complaints arrived from people who had missed their connection even though their train had reached the station on time.

The transport office initially looked for mistakes in the timetable. None were found. The difficulty was that the ten-minute connection had been measured from the arrival of the train at the platform to the departure of the bus from its stop. It did not include the time passengers might need to leave a crowded carriage, reach the footbridge and collect a bicycle or a large bag. What looked like a generous interval on paper was not necessarily a usable interval for everyone.

To investigate, staff observed the route between the platform and the bus stop over five evenings. They also invited passengers to describe their journeys. The two sources did not provide identical information. Observation showed where groups slowed down, whereas the written accounts explained why some people needed to stop. A parent reported waiting for a child to use the station facilities; another passenger avoided the footbridge because the lift was unreliable. These were not errors in reading the timetable. They were conditions that the timetable alone did not reveal.

One proposal was simply to delay every bus by another ten minutes. Several passengers supported it, but the bus operators raised a practical concern. The same vehicles continued beyond the three districts to serve a small college. A later departure from the station could make those passengers late for the final class of the evening. Changing one connection could improve a journey for one group while making another journey less reliable. The question was therefore not whether additional waiting time was useful, but where and under what conditions it should be introduced.

The town tried a more limited change. For six weeks, the first bus after the busiest train waited an additional five minutes. The other services kept their published departure times. Staff placed signs along the walking route and asked the station to check the lift before the evening peak. This trial combined a timetable change with improvements to the connection itself. Consequently, a reduction in missed buses would not, on its own, show which part of the trial had produced the improvement.

At the end of the trial, fewer complaints had been received. The transport office treated this as encouraging rather than decisive. A complaint count depends not only on the number of problems but also on whether passengers know where to report them and believe that reporting is worthwhile. The number of rail passengers had also varied during the trial. The office therefore compared complaints with observed missed connections and passenger numbers. It did not publish the lower complaint count as proof that every user had benefited.

The final recommendation retained the extra wait after the busiest train and made responsibility for the lift checks explicit. It also proposed another review during the college term, when travel patterns might differ. Some residents regarded the continued review as unnecessary caution; others welcomed the acknowledgement that a useful arrangement could still need adjustment. The case suggests that a timetable is best understood as a statement of an intended service, rather than a guarantee that every person can make every connection. Assessing that service requires attention to the journey around the scheduled departure as well as to the time printed beside it.

materials.title: A trial of later library opening

paragraphs.text: Good afternoon. Today I want to explain how our college evaluated a trial of later library opening. You may have seen the announcement saying that the trial was successful. That description needs a little care. The library was used more often in the evening, but that does not answer every question about whether the change should become permanent. I will go through what changed, what we measured and what we still need to find out.

First, the practical arrangement. Before the trial, the library closed at six on weekdays. During the trial it stayed open until eight, but only on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We did not add weekend hours. The original proposal had included Monday as well, and some early notices referred to three evenings. However, there were not enough trained staff to cover all three. Anyone using those early notices would have had the wrong information, so the final timetable was placed beside the entrance and sent to students.

The aim was not simply to increase the total number of visits. Students on placement had told us that they often returned to campus too late to use specialist materials. Other students said their accommodation was too noisy for concentrated work. Those are different needs. A student might require access to a particular collection, or might only need a quiet desk. We wanted to know which need the extra hours were actually meeting before deciding how to use the available staff and space.

For eight weeks, the team recorded entrances during the extra hours. They also asked visitors to complete a short form when they left. I should stress that the entrance figures were visits, not separate individuals. Someone who came on six evenings appeared six times in the total. It would therefore be misleading to report the total as the number of students who had benefited. The forms helped us see patterns of use, although not everyone chose to complete one.

The most common reason given on the forms was the need for a quiet place to work. Access to specialist materials was mentioned less often. That finding led one member of the team to suggest opening a supervised study room instead of the whole library. It might meet much of the demand at a lower staffing cost. But another member pointed out that a less common need can still be important. A small group may depend on equipment or collections that cannot be moved into an ordinary room.

We also compared the two evenings. Thursday was usually busier than Tuesday, but the difference became smaller after the deadline for a major course assignment had passed. We cannot assume that students always prefer Thursday. Nor can we say that later opening improved examination results: the trial did not measure them. Increased use is useful evidence about access, not direct evidence about academic achievement. When you read the short report, keep that distinction in mind.

Our recommendation is to keep the two late evenings for one more term while testing a supervised study room on another day. This is a proposed next step, not an approved timetable, so students should not arrive next Monday expecting the new room to be open. Before it starts, the college needs to confirm staffing and access arrangements. We will compare costs, types of use and the experience of students who need specialist resources. We also plan to ask people who did not attend the trial, because a service can look popular while still failing to reach some of those it was intended to help. That wider review should give us a better basis for a permanent decision.

paragraphs.text: The workshop controller and the maintenance unit use a local reserve supply. They do not depend on the harbour main generator, and the ferry battery must remain on the ferry. The test lamp fixed to the workshop frame is part of this local system; it is not the navigation beacon needed for the evacuation.

To use the inspection passage without crossing the front scan area, either isolate the maintenance unit at this controller or select Fixed Inspection. In Fixed Inspection, the unit continues examining the fixed lamp until the operator cancels the mode. There is no automatic return to normal operation. This mode releases the side-door interlock, but it does not make the front scan area safe.

Isolation stops the unit and also releases the side-door interlock. Once the unit has been physically disabled, changing a switch cannot repair it. The inner bolt opens a separate return door to the square; that bolt is independent of the inspection-mode interlock. Leave the harbour generator off while its inspection is incomplete.

Sending them on the same trip as the module will not meet that requirement. The weather panels and the archive case can go on either trip. Choose which of those two you would prefer to receive earlier, but keep both trips within their capacity. These are additional deliveries; the basic safety work is not waiting for this choice.

materials.title: Local-control trial: scope and recorded conditions

paragraphs.text: These are short local trials of Controller A. Each run lasted ten minutes with the isolation check completed. The reported load is measured in the trial apparatus’s own units; no outside engineering calculation is required. “Stable” means the apparatus met the declared condition for those ten minutes, not that it has been approved for every tower or for permanent use.

Run T1 used load 40 with the reserve connected and remained stable. T2 used load 70 with the reserve connected and stopped. T3 used load 40 without the reserve and stopped. T4 repeated the T1 configuration and remained stable. No run tested load 55, and none tested full-scale operation across the six regional towers.

To compare the recorded effect of changing load while holding the listed configuration constant, compare T1 and T2. T1 and T3 address a different change. A careful report should describe which conditions have actually been observed and leave untested combinations open. Further trials and field checks remain necessary before any wider operating proposal can be accepted.

# COM-MAT-01：西工坊观察记录

用途：既有工坊材料的可选现场补充，不覆盖Q-102已定正文。版本0.1，原创6.5目标制作稿，尚无试测。

The maintenance unit is still operating from its own reserve. Switching off the harbour generator will therefore not stop it. Its movements follow a short inspection cycle, but the direction of each attack should be checked before anyone enters the marked area.

An arm strike follows the person selected by the unit. Moving to another position does not, by itself, remove that person from danger. A scanning sweep is different: it covers the indicated section of the floor. Anyone outside that section is clear of the sweep, provided that no other warning applies.

Repeated pressure may interrupt the unit, although it needs time to recover before the same method can work again. Do not assume that every hit will cancel an attack. A prepared device is useful only when the unit actually starts the action for which the device was set.

The replacement bracket remains on the inner shelf. Stopping the unit creates access; it does not collect the part or repair the ferry. The fixed inspection stand and the ferry's navigation beacon are separate pieces of equipment.

制作边界：字幕/中文提示可用；没有语音成品；资料不宣称新的航道已开放。伤害数字由中文或双语战斗UI直接显示，不靠材料隐藏基础安全警告。

# COM-MAT-02：潮门塔检修程序

用途：Q-104本地虚构装置规则。原创6.5目标制作稿，未经外部标定。不是现实电气维修指南。

Both cooling valves must be closed before the local supply can be isolated. The order in which the valves are closed does not matter. However, isolating the supply is not a substitute for closing either valve.

The two valve controls are positioned at the front of the maintenance area. The isolation control is at the rear. A qualified member of the crew may operate a control after reaching the corresponding working position. No particular tool model is required for the normal procedure.

Once both valves are closed, the protective lock around the unit will release. The crew can then bring the unit under control. If the isolation step has not been completed, the system will remain in a holding state rather than register a safe shutdown.

Check the displayed positions instead of relying on an earlier confirmation. Changing a relevant connection makes the previous check insufficient. Ordinary protective equipment can reduce the risk to the crew, but it cannot change the valve settings or certify the installation.

Take time to read the current warnings. The inspection record is not a test of how quickly a message can be read.

答案边界：两阀可交换；隔离必须在两阀之后；净化/盾/暴露不代替设备动作；一切为本游戏受控虚构条件。

materials.title: # COM-MAT-03：中央机组交接录音脚本

body.markdown:
# COM-MAT-03：中央机组交接录音脚本

状态：仅脚本；双人；建议作为暂停可重播的现场材料。原创6.5目标稿，实际语速/音质及任务负担需另测，无已完成音轨。

Technician: Rook no longer controls the command layer, but that does not mean the maintenance programme has stopped. The relays can restart it without another order from him.

Inspector: Then the first step is to isolate the two local links and verify their present configuration?

Technician: Correct. Either link can be dealt with first. Do not proceed on the basis of an old check if somebody has changed the connections.

Inspector: What happens after the unit reaches the first holding point?

Technician: We can address the automatic restart. Both relay assemblies have to be inactive before the bypass can be latched. Reaching the holding point alone does not prove that the relays are inactive.

Inspector: And the final stop?

Technician: Set the damping arrangement, verify it, and then authorise the controlled stop. Authorisation applies to that checked arrangement. It does not give us permission to alter the connections and keep using the same record.

Inspector: Understood. We will report that the central programme is stable once those steps are complete. We will not describe the entire network as converted.

Technician: Exactly. The regional preparations and the final operating decision remain separate matters.

制作要求：录音不替代工程完成回执；可调音量和字幕；不能因为已读本稿便把最终政策或语言掌握置为完成。

# NPC-MAT-01：哈文核对行动
类型：对话脚本。目标：IELTS Academic 6.5；未校准，未配音。
场景：R1-S03或R1-S04的合法通信入口。条件：玩家已经提交当前撤离提案；相关设备材料可见。
用途：回应已提出的意图，不在首次接受任务时自动给出全部答案。任何方案、字段或设备配置改变后按QEV重新核对。
允许影响：形成待玩家确认的行动摘要；不得仅因对白播放而离港。

**Havel:** You have explained which route you want to use. Before I pass the instruction to the crew, I need to check that we mean the same thing by “ready”.

**Player:** Which part is still unclear?

**Havel:** The spare light can work, but that is not the same as having it fitted and tested on this ferry. Your note says the crew can leave after the bracket is replaced. Does that also include connecting the onboard battery and checking the complete arrangement?

**Player:** Yes. They should complete those steps before departure, and repeat the check if a connection changes.

**Havel:** That gives them a clear sequence. I will keep the main generator out of this plan. The inspection team has not yet confirmed that it is safe to use.

**Player:** Please show me the final instruction before you send it.

**Havel:** Of course. Nothing leaves this desk until you have confirmed the actual arrangement. A clear plan is useful; a plan that describes work as finished when it is not would cause a different problem.

制作说明：玩家台词为可接受意图示例，不要求照抄。实际收尾由Q-102设备、提案与提交规则执行。

materials.title: # NPC-MAT-02：莉娜选择怎样联系家人

body.markdown:
# NPC-MAT-02：莉娜选择怎样联系家人
类型：对话脚本。目标：IELTS Academic 6.5；未校准，未配音。
场景：R6-S02或双方许可的HUB-S01中继。条件：CQ-LINA-02与本人回信核验完成；CQ-LINA-03正在进行。
隐私：回信不自动向同伴全队公开；不在本脚本加入具体住址。

**Lina:** I used to think that finding him would settle everything. It would at least tell me whether I should keep looking. Now there is a reply, and I am not sure what to ask first.

**Player:** He has agreed to exchange letters. He has not agreed to a visit yet.

**Lina:** I know. I do not want you to turn a small permission into a promise on his behalf. Please tell him that I received his message. He does not have to explain all those years in one letter.

**Player:** Would you like to suggest meeting, or leave that for another reply?

**Lina:** Suggest it as a possibility, not an arrangement. I would like to see him, but he has a life there. If he would rather continue writing for now, send me the answer as it is.

制作说明：此为“希望询问见面可能性”的一条分支；其他可接受分支为继续通信或双方明确暂缓。不得将同意通信投影为同意见面。见面实际安排仍检查双方当前许可，不靠语气评分。

# NPC-MAT-03：修复不是免除责任
类型：三方对话脚本。目标：IELTS Academic 6.5；未校准，未配音。
场景：R3-S03；CQ-OREN-02辅助警报器已实际修复，独立复核尚待完成。
不改变：Q-302的签章事实、Q-304的主线结果。

**Oren:** The signal now reaches both rooms. I replaced the damaged connection, and the spare parts are listed here. Someone other than me should test it before the residents rely on it.

**Pera:** That is a useful repair. It does not answer why the earlier equipment was accepted with the safety check incomplete.

**Oren:** I am not asking it to. I signed that record, and I should have refused. I can explain the pressure I was under, but that does not make the signature belong to someone else.

**Player:** What can be agreed today without closing the wider review?

**Pera:** We can appoint a reviewer for this repair and make the result available to the residents. His statement about the earlier check must remain separate. I will not write that everyone has forgiven him.

**Oren:** Then record the repair and the remaining questions separately. I can also train someone to repeat the test. I will not always be here to do it.

制作说明：修复件来自本支线工坊包，不挪用六塔主物资。玩家不需要说服佩拉“原谅”才能完成安全复核。此处不复制主线验收奖励。

materials.title: # NPC-MAT-04：查验申请不等于公开许可

body.markdown:
# NPC-MAT-04：查验申请不等于公开许可
类型：受控审阅说明与对话。目标：IELTS Academic 6.5；未校准，未配音。
场景：R4-S04；CQ-MIRA-02。局部证人使用W-04代号；不承载主线唯一证据。

## Review request
The reviewer needs to confirm when the record was received, which role the witness held, and whether the copy matches the original. A home address is not required for this review. The permission already given applies to one named reviewer and to this purpose only. It does not permit publication on the notice board or forwarding to a wider group.

## Dialogue
**Mira:** We can send the relevant fields without pretending that the rest of the record has disappeared.

**June:** Keep the original in controlled storage. The reviewer can receive the comparison sheet and a record of how it was prepared.

**Player:** What happens if the reviewer asks for more information later?

**Mira:** We check the new request. If it needs a different permission, we ask for that permission before sending anything. We should not describe the first agreement as consent to every future use.

**June:** And if a copy has already been delivered, changing the permission does not make the recipient forget it. We can restrict future sharing and record the correction, but we must be honest about what has happened.

制作说明：自由正文中的身份信息也受同样限制，不能只检查附件标签。参考模型仅检查结构化范围，不声称已能审查任意英文泄露。

# NPC-MAT-05：不把意愿写成完成
类型：三方交接脚本。目标：IELTS Academic 6.5；未校准，未配音。
场景：R6-S08；CQ-TESS-03。只说明本地通知链，不新增六方协议或终局条件。

**Finn:** The local team has accepted the next watch. The equipment is on the delivery record, but one handover has not been confirmed. Those are two separate facts.

**Tess:** Then do not send a message saying that everything is ready. Tell the receiving team what has arrived, what still needs checking, and who can answer if something is missing.

**Player:** We can keep the original contact and add a second person. Does the receiving team agree to that arrangement?

**Finn:** They have agreed to the second contact, provided both people can see the same current record. I have their reply here.

**Tess:** Good. I may still disagree with the decision about the wider network. That is not a reason to leave this handover unfinished. People will need a working arrangement under any of the plans we are considering.

**Player:** I will confirm the local message separately from the final operating agreement.

**Finn:** That is the right distinction. This reply closes a local communication task; it does not replace a trial, deliver another crate, or sign on behalf of all six regions.

制作说明：角色的政治分歧不撤销已履行义务；设备、试验、协议依旧读取真实回执。

# NPC-MAT-06：甲板上的椅子
类型：生活对话。目标语境：6.5项目；日常句可自然简短，未校准，未配音。
场景：HUB-S01；莉娜、奥伦已经招募且同时可用。无额外奖励，不携带主线秘密。

**Lina:** I thought you fixed that chair yesterday.

**Oren:** I did. Today I am making it quieter.

**Lina:** It was perfectly quiet while nobody was sitting on it.

**Oren:** That was not the condition I was testing.

**Lina:** Then write a warning: safe for people who never sit down.

**Oren:** Or you could hold this part while I tighten the other side.

**Lina:** All right. But when it is finished, we are allowed to use it. You cannot keep every repaired object as an unfinished experiment.

**Oren:** Agreed. Sit down after I put the last screw back.

制作说明：一次安全节点展示；可以暂停。人物实际占用由QEV统一调度，不能因这段小场景挪走正在战斗或施工的人。
